title: Ensure branch deletions are denied
description: Deleting a protected branch removes both the code and the protections attached to it; recreating it restores neither. Azure Repos refuses to delete a branch with a Required policy, except for holders of both "Force push (rewrite history and delete branches)" and "Bypass policies when pushing". Without a required policy, anyone with Force push — including the branch's creator — can delete it.
remediation: Add a Required branch policy to the default branch at Project settings -> Repositories -> <repository> -> Policies -> Branch Policies -> <default branch> (or for every repository at Project settings -> Repositories -> All Repositories -> Policies -> Branch Policies -> + -> "Protect the default branch of each repository"): Azure Repos then refuses to delete it. Review who holds both Force push and "Bypass policies when pushing" at Repos -> Branches -> <default branch> -> More options -> Branch security; they can still delete it. allowedBypassPrincipals and thresholds.maxBypassPrincipals work as for CIS-1.1.15.
fixSummary: Add a required branch policy at Project settings -> Repositories -> <repo> -> Policies.
